name: mnemonic_cull_projector
label: Mnemonic Cull Projector
poeticVision: Feel the wrenching choice of turning a precious, tangible piece of your past into a desperate shield or a searing projectile. Every shot is a moment of forgetting, a silent scream as a fragment of who you were shatters into energy, leaving behind a colder, emptier echo in your mind. The adrenaline of survival is laced with the bitter grief of self-erasure, as you actively choose what part of yourself to abandon to survive the immediate threat.

parameters.name: memory_selection_ui_scene
parameters.description: The PackedScene for the UI that allows players to select a memory to cull.

parameters.name: memory_projectile_scene
parameters.description: The PackedScene for the projectile instantiated when a memory is culled.

parameters.name: cull_effect_scene
parameters.description: The PackedScene for the full-screen visual feedback effect (a CanvasLayer with a ColorRect and ShaderMaterial).

parameters.name: projectile_speed
parameters.description: The speed at which the memory projectile is launched.

parameters.name: available_memories
parameters.description: An array of MemoryFragmentResource instances representing Lyra's currently held memories.

verdict: A brilliant, agonizing mechanic that weaponizes the very essence of self, forcing players to choose between immediate survival and the precious fragments of who they once were.
impact: This mechanic will force players into agonizing, high-stakes decisions, making every combat encounter a personal sacrifice. It will deepen the emotional connection to Lyra's identity and the struggle against forgetting, transforming resource management into a profound act of self-erasure, ensuring that every victory is tinged with the bitter taste of loss.
